subject: How to print vector elements of an output object?

messages.author: 6dffb1c25cde17a3
messages.subject: How to print vector elements of an output object?
parts:
Hi,

my app takes input of probabilities (have to sum to one) in sliders and makes a plot according to these values.
The trick is that after changing the value of one slider, the new probabilities have to be normed to sum to one. That means that the actual value of the slider will depend on the other values and the probability will not be exactly what the user set it to.
For now, I am happy if the slider values stays at where the user sets if the actual normed probabilities are plotted next to it. On my ui.R, I can print all the values with textOutput, but I could not figure out how to print each element of the vector next to the corresponding slider. How do I access the elements of the vector output$probabilities?

This is what I have on my server.R:

output$renorm = renderText({
  pi.star = (unlist(reactiveValuesToList(input)[paste0("pi”,1:3)]))
  pi.star.renorm = pi.star/sum(pi.star)
  return(pi.star.renorm)
})


And that is what I have on my ui.R:

sliderInput("pi1", div(withMathJax(" \\( \\pi^*_1: \\) ")), min = 0, max = 1, value = 1/3),
textOutput("renorm"),
sliderInput("pi2", "\\( \\pi^*_2: \\)", min = 0, max = 1, value = 1/3),
...

PS: I also had a uiOutput command to create the sliders with a loop, but that didn’t work (I got the sliders to print, but I couldn’t get the input values). Any help on that would also be appreciated.

Thanks,
Thais
